caption: The drawing depicts a long, double-breasted coat rendered in shades of tan and brown. The coat features a high collar, long sleeves with decorative cuffs, and a set of two symmetrical rows of round buttons running down the front. Each cuff is adorned with two horizontal brown stripes and three buttons, while the large rectangular pocket on the left side is closed with two flaps, each decorated with two buttons and outlined with darker brown bands. There are additional seam or trim lines marked with darker strokes at the shoulders and along the edge of the collar. The coat flares gently at the bottom, with a pleat visible on the side. Above and to the right of the main illustration, a smaller, sketched outline of the back of the coat is present, showing additional button and flap details at the back and more lines indicating pleats or gathers. The background is plain and uncolored, and the overall composition is focused on illustrating the coat’s front and back views and structural details.
title: Woman's Coat
